target: 797 Statu Determinando

source: 797 Determining the Situation
target: 797 Statu Determinando

source: Looking at the swollen, blue‐black corpse on the counter, Lumian chuckled to himself, They’re not even trying to hide it, are they?
target: Spectans cadaver tumidum, caeruleo‐nigrum super mensam, Lumian sibi subridens ait: “Non etiam conantur celare, nonne?”

source: Classic Morora, the City of Exiles…
target: Classica Morora, Urbs Exulorum…

source: Lumian did a quick inspection, confirming that the highly decayed corpse was indeed the other body part of the Abscessed Hand.
target: Lumian celeriter inspicuit, confirmans cadaver valde corruptum revera esse aliam partem corporis Manus Abscessae.

source: Besides missing the left half, the corresponding part of the head, and the Abscessed Hand’s body itself, it was fairly intact.
target: Praeter absentiam dimidiae sinistrae, partem capitis correspondens, atque ipsum corpus Manus Abscessae, illa satis integra manebat.

source: If it weren’t for the rotting flesh at the spine writhing and trying to regenerate, Lumian might have doubted that the two steaks served to him and Albus had come from this corpse, let alone that dozens, perhaps hundreds, of such “steaks” had been sold.
target: Si non esset caro putrida in spina, quae contorquebatur et regenerari conabatur, Lumian fortasse dubitasset quin duo “steaks”, quibus ei et Albo oblata erant, eodem cadavro provenirent, nedum quin non paucos—fortasse centena—talium “steaks” vendita essent.

source: This made Lumian frown slightly, a question he had pondered earlier resurfacing in his mind: Must I do a recall of all the steaks sold?
target: Hoc faciens, Lumian leviter frontem corripiebat; quaestio, quam antea meditaverat, iterum in mente apparuit: “Oportetne mihi omnes venditas ‘steaks’ recolere?”

source: Judging by the corpse’s completeness, it doesn’t seem necessary…
target: Ex integritate cadaveris, id non videtur necesse esse…

source: Moreover, the residents of Morora had been eating such steaks for some time.
target: Praeterea, incolae Morora iamdiu talia “steaks” edebant.

source: Who knows if they’ve actually digested and absorbed the rotten flesh…
target: Quis sciat num vere carnem putridam digeruerint atque absoruerint…

source: From what I sense about the subtle connections between the corpse, even if digested, the rotten flesh likely just changes form without fundamentally altering…
target: Ex intuendo meo de subtilibus nexibus inter cadaver, etsi digesta sit, caro putrida verisimiliter solum formam mutat, non tamen radicaliter.

source: As he pondered, Lumian quickly stuffed the half-decayed corpse into the Traveler’s Bag, using the Sword of Courage and other plain swords to separate it from the other half to prevent unwanted fusion before finding the head.
target: Dum meditaret, Lumian celeriter dimidium corruptum cadaver in Saccum Viatoris coniecit, utens Gladio Virtutis et aliis gladiis simplicibus, ut ea ab altero dimidio segregaret, ne fusio inopina eveniret, priusquam caput inveniret.

source: “So we were served this stuff, and it looked pretty appetizing,” Albus’s voice came from the kitchen doorway as Lumian put away the half of the Abscessed Hand.
target: “Ita nobis hoc oblata est, et satis edule videbatur,” vox Albi ex ianuā culinae prodiit, dum Lumian dimidium Manus Abscessae recondidit.

source: Albus, the former member of the Iron and Blood Cross Order and Medici family member, wore a black jacket with dark red patterns, one hand in his pocket, marveling.
target: Albus, pristinus Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis atque membrum familiae Medici, indutus erat iaccā nigra cum figuris rubris obscuris, una manu in sinu, admirans.

source: He didn’t seem disgusted by almost eating rotten flesh steak.
target: Non videbatur abhorrescere, cum prope “steaks” carnis putridae edisset.

source: Lumian turned and responded with a smile, “I was looking forward to seeing what changes you’d undergo after eating it.”
target: Lumian se vertit et subrisus respondit: “Exspectabam videre quales mutationes subies postquam id comederis.”

source: “Gradually gain some self-healing ability, become stronger on moonlit nights, and learn some dark spells,” Albus replied in a report-like tone.
target: “Paulatim aliquam facultatem se curandi adipisces, noctibus lunatis fortior fies, et incantationes obscuras discere,” respondit Albus, tono quasi relationis.

source: “But in return, self-control would significantly decrease, intelligence would regress, and nightmares would be frequent.”
target: “Sed pro invicem, moderatio multum decrescet, intelligentia recedet, et incubi frequenter apparebunt.”

source: “So, you came to investigate after noticing the odd behavior of those guys?” Lumian asked with a smile.
target: “Itaque, venisti ad investigandum postquam insolitum illorum comportamen animadvertivisti?” quaesivit Lumian subrisus.

source: He wasn’t really seeking confirmation; he had already determined it.
target: Non vere confirmationem quaerebat; iam id statuerat.

source: He was using this question to indicate that he was also investigating and hadn’t come specifically for the half-corpse.
target: Quaestionem hanc adhibebat ut indicaret se quoque investigare nec solum ad dimidium cadaveris venerit.

source: “A Hunter must conceal their true purpose to avoid traps set by others.”
target: “Venator verum finem suum celare debet, ne ab aliis insidiis capiatur.”

source: The red-haired Albus smiled.
target: Albus, cum capillis rufis, subrisit.

source: “They tried to keep this a secret, hoping only they and their collaborators could enjoy this bar’s special food.”
target: “Conati sunt hoc arcani servare, sperantes quod tantum ipsi et socii eorum cibum peculiare huius tabernae frui possent.”

source: “Who in Morora isn’t selfish?” Lumian asked, changing the topic.
target: “Quis in Morora non est sui ipsius cupidus?” quaesivit Lumian, rem mutans.

source: “How did you notice their intelligence regression?”
target: “Quomodo animadvertivisti eorum recedentem intelligentiam?”

source: Albus raised his right hand, palm up.
target: Albus dextram manum levavit, palma sursum.

source: “If their intelligence hadn’t regressed, how could they have revealed their secret to me so easily, leading me to this bar?”
target: “Si intelligentia eorum non recederet, quomodo facile secreta sua mihi revelata essent, quae me ad hanc tabernam duxerint?”

source: Lumian nodded slightly, looking thoughtful.
target: Lumian leviter annuit, aspectu cogitativo.

source: “So, should I kill you to keep this secret from spreading?”
target: “Itaque, te occidam, ne hic secretus divulgetur?”

source: Albus met Lumian’s gaze calmly, smiling.
target: Albus oculos Lumiani tranquille convenit, subrisus.

source: “Do you think those idiots can keep a secret?”
target: “Num credis illos stultos secretum retinere posse?”

source: With that, the Medici family member turned and walked towards the bar hall, exposing his back to Lumian.
target: Hoc facto, membrum familiae Medici se vertit et ad atrium tabernae processit, dorsum Lumiano ostendens.

source: Lumian stood still, watching him leave, as if deep in thought.
target: Lumian stabat immotus, eum discedentem observans, quasi penitus meditans.

source: For a moment, he had the urge to kill.
target: Aliquando, impulsum occidendi eum percussit.

source: He considered using this chance to eliminate Albus Medici to prevent him from interfering with his approach to 0-01, or even marking it for the Red Angel before him.
target: Cogitavit hanc occasionem uti ad Album Medici eliminandum, ne in accessu ad 0‑01 interveniret, aut ut ante eum pro Angelo Rubro signaretur.

source: Ultimately, Lumian resisted this impulse.
target: Finaliter, Lumian hunc impulsum repulit.

source: For two reasons: First, he judged that becoming an experimental subject would severely impact his self-awareness.
target: Duo erant causae: Primo, aestimavit fieri subiectum experimentale graviter conscientiam suam laesurum.

source: Unless it was his only option, he didn’t want to try it.
target: Nisi unica optio esset, id conari noluit.

source: In that case, having an extra person, a “cannon fodder” to help navigate the dangers, was a viable strategy.
target: In hoc casu, habere personam extra, “cannon fodder”, ad pericula superanda adiuvandum, consilium valde idoneum erat.

source: Second, he wasn’t confident he could kill Albus Medici.
target: Secundo, non confidit se Album Medici interficere posse.

source: If Albus was still in the same state as when they explored the Red Swan Castle, he would be easily dealt with, but several months had passed.
target: Si Albus in eodem statu maneret, ut cum Rubro Cygno Castello exploraverunt, facile tractabilis esset, sed menses plurimi transierant.

source: He had become a Reaper and had even fully digested the corresponding potion.
target: Factus erat Messor et potionem ad id pertinens plene digeriverat.

source: It was unlikely the other party hadn’t made any progress.
target: Improbabile erat ne altera pars ullam profectionem non fecerit.

source: Moreover, if Albus was indeed representing the Red Angel in approaching 0-01, the King of Angels would likely enhance His descendant’s strength, providing powerful items to ensure he was among the apex below demigods, capable of handling Morora’s dangers.
target: Praeterea, si Albus revera Angelum Rubrum in accessu ad 0‑01 repraesentaret, Rex Angelorum verisimiliter vires posteritatis eius augeret, potentes res suppeditans, ut inter apex infra semideos esse possit ad pericula Morora superanda toleranda.

source: Lumian didn’t leave the kitchen immediately.
target: Lumian culinam statim non reliquit.

source: He checked around again.
target: Circumspiciebat iterum.

source: He was looking for any other special ingredients—the bar owner’s slightly sluggish behavior made him suspect it was caused by randomly eating something in Morora, a common cause of death for Beyonders of the Gourmet pathway.
target: Quaerebat alias ingredientes speciales – morosa paulo tarditas tabernarii eum suspicari faciebat, quod fortuito aliquid in Morora edendi causa communi mortis Beyonderum in via Gourmet fiebat.

source: Unfortunately, Lumian only found ordinary ingredients like flour, butter, and milk.
target: Infeliciter, Lumian tantum ingredientes ordinaris invenit, ut farinam, butyrum, atque lac.

source: He then went up to the second floor of the Carnivore bar, entering the Depriver’s bedroom.
target: Deinde ascendit ad tabulatum secundum tabernae Carnivoris, et in cubiculum Depriveris ingressus est.

source: He planned to stay here as the duel winner for the time being.
target: Cogitavit manere hic, ut ad tempus victor duelli esset.

source: The bedroom was cleaner than Lumian expected—no grease stains, no cockroaches, mice, or insects.
target: Cubiculum purius erat quam Lumian speraverat—nullae maculae unctuosae, neque blattae, neque mures, neque alia insecta erant.

source: Aside from being slightly messy, it was fine.
target: Praeter modicum inordinatum, statim conveniebat.

source: Lumian walked around the bedroom, trying to activate the black mark on his right shoulder to see if he could teleport out of Morora.
target: Lumian per cubiculum ambulavit, conans signum nigrum in umero dextro suo activare, ut videret num ex Morora se teleportare posset.

source: He couldn’t sense any of the places he had been to.
target: Non poterat sentire ullos locos quos antea visitaverat.

source: As expected, I can’t leave.
target: Ut expectatum est, non possum exire.

source: I can only teleport within this mountainous area… But it’s not like Morora residents want to leave… I wonder if Albus has such thoughts…
target: Ego solum intra hanc montuosam regionem teleportare possum… Sed non videtur incolis Mororae exire velle… Miror an Albus talem animum habeat…

source: Lumian muttered silently, taking out ritual materials from the Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian submurmuravit tacite, materias rituales e Sacco Viatoris extrahens.

source: He conducted his second experiment: Summoning a messenger!
target: Experimentum secundum perfecit: nuntium evocans!

source: But neither the doll messenger nor his own messenger responded to his call.
target: Sed nec nuntius ex pupula nec nuntius proprius ad vocem eius respondit.

source: Disconnected from the spirit world?
target: Disiunctus a mundo spirituali?

source: At least to some extent…
target: Saltem ad aliquam mensuram…

source: As expected from a place sealing 0-01…
target: Sicut exspectabatur, ex loco quod 0‑01 sigillaret…

source: Lumian stood at the window, gazing at the dim environment and the slightly less intense rain, feeling the cold dampness seeping in.
target: Lumian ad fenestram stetit, aspiciens ambitum obscuratum et pluviam paulo minorem intensitatis, frigorem humiditatis se infiltrantem sentiens.

source: He proceeded with the third experiment according to his plan.
target: Tertium experimentum secundum consilium suum prosecutus est.

source: He walked to the full-length mirror in the room, placed his right hand on it, and activated a black mark on his body.
target: Ad speculum totum in conclavi stetit, dextrem manum superposuit, et signum nigrum in corpore suo activavit.

source: He was using the contractual ability from Bloody Jack to sense the mirror marks he had left elsewhere!
target: Utebatur facultate contractuali ex “Bloody Jack” ad signa speculi, quae alibi reliquerat, sentienda!

source: In the blink of an eye, Lumian sensed three faint marks through the mirror.
target: In momento oculi, Lumian per speculum tres signa tenues sensit.

source: They were in Moron Avigny’s study, the Blue Avenger’s treasury, and Franca and Jenna’s rented apartment.
target: Erat ea in studio Moronis Avigny, in thesauro Vindicis Caeruli, et in locato habitatione Francae et Jennae.

source: This meant that if Lumian could enter the mirror, he might be able to use his teleportation ability to reach the mirrors corresponding to these marks.
target: Hoc significabat: si Lumian in speculum intrare posset, fortasse facultate teleportationis ad specula correspondentia his signis pervenire posset.

source: Even if not, he should be able to exchange information with the outside world through them!
target: Etiam si non, per ea informationem cum orbe exterio commutare posset!

source: Lumian was both pleasantly surprised and satisfied that his hypothesis was confirmed.
target: Lumian et laetus et contentus erat quod hypothesim suam confirmatam esse videret.

source: Having read the 0-01 data, he knew its origin and its connection to Fourth Epoch Trier.
target: Postquam data 0‑01 lecta erant, originem eius et nexum ad Quartam Epocham Trier noverat.

source: Given the similar sealing methods, many details should also be consistent–Trier had a special mirror world, so this place likely did too.
target: Propter modos sigillandi similes, multa quoque compatenda esse videntur—Trier habebat mundum specularum specialem, itaque hoc loco idem verisimile est.

source: Trier had Mirror People, so this place likely had them too!
target: Trier habebat Populum Specularum, itaque hoc loco verisimiliter eos habet quoque!

source: The experimental subjects’ detail, “if not blindfolded, the one who leaves the mausoleum will be a monster resembling him,” was evidence of the Mirror People and the special mirror world’s existence.
target: Commentarium subiectorum experimentalis, “nisi caecati erint, qui mausoleum relinquit, monstrum eum simile erit,” testimonium erat de Populo Specularum atque exsistentia mundi specularis specialis.

source: Based on these premises, Lumian thought using the mirror world’s abilities might establish some contact with the outside world.
target: His praemissis innixus, Lumian putavit facultates mundi specularis ad aliquod contactum cum orbe exterio constituendum esse.

source: With this hypothesis, he borrowed the Mirror Cufflink from Franca, who had become a Demoness of Affliction.
target: Hoc hypothesi innixus, mutuatus est “Mirror Cufflink” ab Franca, quae Daemona Afflictionis facta erat.

source: In a few days, she could use the pretext of investigating Mirror People to request charms from the Demoness Sect that would allow her to use the mirror world for teleportation.
target: In paucis diebus illa poterit praetexto investigationis Populi Specularum adhibere, ut ab Secta Daemona incantamenta petat, quae ei sinerent uti mundo speculari pro teleportatione.

source: Lumian reached into the Traveler’s Bag and took out the glass-like cufflink.
target: Lumian in Sacco Viatoris manum extendit et “Mirror Cufflink,” quasi vitreum, extraxit.

source: He didn’t rush to confirm if it could be used to leave directly or only to transmit information, as the Mirror Cufflink had only four uses left.
target: Non festinavit confirmare num ad directam exitum vel tantum ad informationem transmittendam adhiberi posset, cum “Mirror Cufflink” tantum quattuor usus reliquerat.

source: He’d wait for important information or urgent matters to test it.
target: Exspectaret informationem gravem aut negotia urgenta, ut id experiretur.

source: Grr, grr… At that moment, Lumian’s stomach growled with hunger.
target: Grr, grr… Illo momento, ventris Lumiani fame fremuit.

source: He couldn’t help but gripe internally, Seriously, the Church of Knowledge is so stingy.
target: Non potuit non interne queri: “Serio, Ecclesia Scientiae tam avara est!”

source: Not even a meal or a sip of water before sending me into Morora.
target: Nec quidem cena aut sorbitus aquae, antequam me in Morora mitterent.

source: I’m not Ludwig, who can finish all the prison food…
target: Non sum Ludwig, qui omnem cibum carceris consumere possit…

source: Muttering, Lumian descended to the first floor, intending to cook something in the kitchen and wait for the rain to stop before looking for the Abscessed Hand’s head.
target: Murmurans, Lumian ad tabulatum primum descendit, cogitans aliquid in culina coquere et pluvia cessare exspectare, antequam caput Manus Abscessae quaereret.

source: By now, the bar owner’s body had been taken away by the enforcers, and the bloodstains on the floor had been cleaned, but the destroyed bar counter and the hall’s scorched remains hadn’t been dealt with.
target: Interim, corpus tabernarii a vigilibus abductum erat, et maculae sanguinis in pavimento expurgatae erant, sed mensa deleta atque reliquiae aulae combustae non curatae erant.

source: Glass shards and wood splinters mixed with the scents of liquor and charred wood.
target: Fragmenta vitrea et scindulae lignorum cum odoribus liquoris et ligni combusti miscebantur.

source: Just as Lumian picked up the bar owner’s legacy left by the enforcers- 420 sassen gold-someone walked in from the doorway.
target: Ita ut Lumian hereditatem tabernarii a vigilibus relictam — 420 sassen aurum — sublevit, aliquis ex ostio intravit.

source: It was the humble-looking human meat chef, Lez.
target: Erat Lez, coquus humanarum carnium, aspectu humili.

source: Lez was soaked, glanced around, and asked Lumian, “Are you hiring a chef here?”
target: Lez madidus erat, circumspexit, ac Lumiano rogavit: “Num hic coquum conducis?”

source: The Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence?
target: Lex Convergence Characteristicarum Beyonder?

source: Lumian suddenly laughed.
target: Lumian subito risit.

source: “Sure, go to the kitchen and make something. I’ll try it and see how it tastes.”
target: “Certe, ad culinam vade et aliquid fac; conabor id et videbo quo modo sapiat.”
